steps.name: sharelink_model
steps.claim: The viewset model and queryset concern ShareLink objects, a resource distinct from the document selected in request data.

steps.name: add_sharelink
steps.claim: For POST, PaperlessObjectPermissions maps the endpoint-level model permission to documents.add_sharelink.

steps.name: authenticated
steps.claim: ShareLinkViewSet lists IsAuthenticated, so the caller must be authenticated before creation proceeds.

steps.name: endpoint_add_sharelink
steps.claim: ShareLinkViewSet also lists PaperlessObjectPermissions; its shown POST mapping requires the global add permission for the ShareLink model, not view permission on the requested document.

steps.name: pass_user_to_serializer
steps.claim: PassUserMixin supplies request.user to ShareLinkSerializer because it is a SerializerWithPerms subclass.

steps.name: validate_exact_document
steps.claim: ShareLinkSerializer's document field resolves the submitted document and invokes validate_document on that exact Document instance before create.

steps.name: create_sharelink
steps.claim: After serializer validation succeeds, CreateModelMixin can create a ShareLink whose document is the validated exact document; the serializer first generates the slug.

steps.name: created
steps.claim: The create request is permitted and returns after creating the share link.

steps.name: user_present
steps.claim: Validation continues only when the serializer received a non-null user.

steps.name: global_view_document
steps.claim: The caller must have the global documents.view_document permission.

steps.name: owner_aware_check
steps.claim: The serializer calls has_perms_owner_aware with the same caller, view_document codename, and exact resolved document.

steps.name: exact_document_access
steps.claim: Validation succeeds only if the owner-aware check returns true for this exact document.

steps.name: validated_document
steps.claim: The exact document is returned to serializer creation after all checks pass.

steps.name: guardian_checker
steps.claim: The helper constructs an ObjectPermissionChecker for the same caller and checks view_document on the exact document when ownership shortcuts do not apply.

steps.name: owner_or_guardian
steps.claim: The helper allows an ownerless document, a document owned by the caller, or a positive Guardian object-permission result.
